note: Canonical feature order shared by Python (ml/lyra/features.py) and C99 (firmware/model/lyra_features.c via the generated lyra_feature_spec.h). Change both together and bump the version.

features.name: emg_acf_peak
features.definition: max normalised biased autocorrelation of (env - mean) over lags 10..50 samples (1-5 Hz periodicity at 50 Hz); 0 if variance <= eps

features.name: imu_acc_band_ratio_1_5hz
features.definition: sum P(1<=f<=5) / sum P(f>0); P = |DFT(periodic-Hann * (||a|| - mean))|^2 at f_k = k*25/N, k=0..N/2; 0 if denominator <= eps

features.name: imu_acc_dom_freq_hz
features.definition: f_k of the lowest bin k with 0.5<=f_k<=8 and P_k >= (1 - 1e-6) * max P over that band (tie-tolerant: quantised still signals give exactly tied bins); 0 if that max <= eps

features.name: imu_tilt_deg
features.definition: atan2(|g1 x g2|, g1.g2) in degrees; g1/g2 = mean acc vector of the first/last 25 samples (1 s); 0 if either norm <= eps

features.name: xmod_corr_env_accmag
features.definition: Pearson r of env25 and ||a||; env25[j] = (env[2j]+env[2j+1])/2; 0 if either sum of squares <= eps

features.name: xmod_coh_1_5hz
features.definition: mean magnitude-squared coherence of env25 and ||a|| at f_k = k*25/16 in [1,5] Hz (k=1,2,3); Welch, segments of 16 with step 8, per-segment mean removed, periodic Hann; bins with Sxx*Syy <= eps give 0; >= 4 segments required (always met for windows >= 2 s)

invalid_window: any non-finite input sample, or a quality check failing (lyra_window_valid), marks the window invalid: no features, no score; the event state machine holds
